name: @proofofwork-agency/headless-plugin
description: OpenCode plugin exposing Headless runner and local ledger tools. Standalone: depends on @proofofwork-agency/headless (install both for npm use).

scripts.build: rm -rf ./dist && bun build ./index.ts --outfile ./dist/index.js --target bun --external @proofofwork-agency/headless --external @opencode-ai/plugin && bunx tsc -p ./tsconfig.build.json --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir ./dist
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun run build
